name: strands-ship
description: Ship your own social-good agent with the Strands toolbox for the AWS Builder Center 'Strands SDK: Workshop to Ship' hackathon: brainstorm an idea from the people you reach, design it from 14 live-tested Strands blocks (SDK tools, MCP, hooks, interventions, graph, swarm, agents-as-tools, sessions, harness, Shell, Decider, Evals, guardrails, voice), build it on Amazon Bedrock, measure it against a one-prompt baseline, record the demo from a live run, check the submission
